consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the Richmond show on October 8, 1983, was a high-energy performance with standout moments, particularly in the second set. Many reviewers highlight the intensity of the playing and the excitement surrounding the opening of the fall tour, though some note a competitive tension between band members.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 50 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the energy and specific performances, there were also critiques regarding the competitive dynamics within the band and the pacing of the show.
